item.title: Shelby’s DeVito selected NW District Player of the Year in Division IV
item.description: FINDLAY — Brayden DeVito’s sensational senior season just got a little better. The Shelby standout was selected the Division IV Player of the Year when the Ohio Prep Sports Media Association unveiled the All-Northwest District team Thursday. DeVito, who will play football for Air Force next fall, averaged 24.1 points per game.
